svg.title: InsightPilot - UML class diagram of the answer presentation
svg.text: UML class diagram - answer presentation (what the analyst sees)
Severity = WARN | FAIL ChartType = BAR | LINE | SCATTER | AREA | PIE ReviewState = UNREVIEWED | REVIEWED
Built by Orchestrator.compose_answer() (Figure 4): TextBlock sentences by the small model from verified hops only; TableBlock and DoubtBlock copied from Hop output and CheckResults.
Every ¹ marker is a Citation to the Hop that produced the number; opening it shows that hop’s SQL, row counts and checks. ChartBlock is produced by the VisualizationAgent [295B].
